Testing Utilities

Modules: superdex.physics.utils.testing.decorators, superdex.physics.utils.testing.environment, superdex.physics.utils.testing.testcases

Fixtures and decorators for suites built on SuperDex Physics.

superdex.physics.utils.testing.decorators

skip(reason: str) → Callable[[Any], Any][source]

Unconditionally skip a test with the given reason. This is a convenience wrapper around skip_if that always skips the test.

skip_if(condition: bool, reason: str) → Callable[[Any], Any][source]

Conditionally skip a test based on a boolean condition. This decorator provides different behavior depending on the environment. If the test is running in internal CI, it will print a skip message and return early, but will not set the skipped flag. This avoids flagging intentionally skipped tests as warnings in the internal CI UI. In other environments, it falls back to unittest.skip() for proper test reporting.

superdex.physics.utils.testing.environment

IS_INTERNAL_CI

Whether the test is running in an internal CI environment or not.
